principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix technical CLI aesthetics with modern chat UI.
Emotion First: The user should feel like a 'Power User' or 'Hacker'.
Content is King: The 'Formula' is the hero. Highlight it.
Negative Space: Don't clutter. Let the chat breathe.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode.

headings.usage: Main titles, Formula outputs, Command names

containers.chat_wrapper: max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full h-[80vh] flex flex-col
containers.input_area: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-3xl px-4

chat_bubble.user: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-6 py-4 max-w-[80%]
chat_bubble.ai: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-6 py-4 max-w-[80%] border border-border/50

formula_display.style: font-mono bg-black/50 border border-accent/20 rounded-lg p-4 text-accent-secondary shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.1)]

input_field.style: bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 focus:border-accent/50 rounded-full px-6 py-4 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300

images.description: Abstract dark geometric background for subtle texture

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons (Send, Copy, Terminal, Settings).

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Force dark mode in 'tailwind.config.js' or 'index.css'. The app should ALWAYS be dark.
3. LAYOUT: Create a 'ChatLayout' component that centers the content and applies the background texture.
5. TYPOGRAPHY: Import 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts for the formula display.
6. INTERACTION: Add hover states to the copy button on the formula card. Add a 'glow' effect to the input field when focused.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to the input field ('chat-input'), send button ('send-button'), and formula output ('formula-output').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic gradients, centered everything).
Do NOT center align the app container globally.
